description:
You are a Transportation Dispatcher at a commercial freight company planning the weekly Boston-to-Fall River delivery run for a heavy tractor-trailer. You must build a complete GPS data package in Garmin BaseCamp so the driver has all critical route information on their Garmin device.

BaseCamp starts empty. Create the following 7 waypoints in My Collection with the exact names, coordinates (decimal degrees), symbols, and comments shown:

1. Name: DEPOT SOUTH BOSTON  |  Lat: 42.3388  Lon: -71.0502  |  Symbol: Building  |  Comment: Home depot. Loading dock hrs 05:00-22:00. Truck entrance off Tide St.
2. Name: BRIDGE HAZARD RT116  |  Lat: 42.1875  Lon: -71.3285  |  Symbol: Danger  |  Comment: CLEARANCE 13'2"! NO TRUCKS OVER 13'2". Alternate: take I-495 S to Rte 1 S.
3. Name: STOP 1 NORTON DIST  |  Lat: 41.9749  Lon: -71.1849  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: Norton Distribution Center. Dock B. Contact 508-555-0177. Est. arrival 09:30.
4. Name: WEIGH STATION RT44  |  Lat: 41.9275  Lon: -71.0142  |  Symbol: Car  |  Comment: MANDATORY stop for oversize/overweight permits. Max axle load 40,000 lbs.
5. Name: STOP 2 TAUNTON CTR  |  Lat: 41.8993  Lon: -71.0940  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: Taunton Industrial Park. Gate code 4821. Dock 3-7. Est. arrival 11:15.
6. Name: STOP 3 FALL RIVER IND  |  Lat: 41.7004  Lon: -71.1548  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: Fall River Industrial Park. Large-format. Load bay 7-10. Est. arrival 13:00.
7. Name: REST STOP I95 S  |  Lat: 41.6543  Lon: -71.0432  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: Certified truck parking. 78 spaces. Facilities available. 10hr rest limit.

Create this route (add waypoints in the exact order listed):

Route — Name: BOSTON-FALL RIVER FREIGHT RUN  |  Waypoints in order: DEPOT SOUTH BOSTON, STOP 1 NORTON DIST, WEIGH STATION RT44, STOP 2 TAUNTON CTR, STOP 3 FALL RIVER IND, REST STOP I95 S

When done, export the entire My Collection as a GPX file and save it to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ with the filename BostonFallRiver_FreightRoute.gpx
